versions.subject: chore: fix typo of lowercase Windows in description
chore: promote older rules status from `experimental` to `test` (#4651)
Merge PR #4728 from @qasimqlf - Update multiple rules to cover the '-' arguments along with '/' arguments
versions.detection:
selection_dir:
    CommandLine|contains: 'dir '
selection_cli_1:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /s'
        - ' -s'
selection_cli_2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /b'
        - ' -b'
condition: all of selection_*

versions.subject: Merge PR #4752 from @frack113 - Update rules to use the `windash` modifier
versions.spl: CommandLine="*dir*-s*" OR CommandLine="*dir*/s*" OR CommandLine="*dir*–s*" OR CommandLine="*dir*—s*" OR CommandLine="*dir*―s*"

versions.subject: Merge PR #4813 from @frack113 - Add Image to avoid FP
versions.detection:
selection_cmd:
    - Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: Cmd.Exe
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|windash: 'dir*-s'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmd.exe" OR OriginalFileName="Cmd.Exe" CommandLine="*dir*-s*" OR CommandLine="*dir*/s*" OR CommandLine="*dir*–s*" OR CommandLine="*dir*—s*" OR CommandLine="*dir*―s*"
